name: Photos

offers.label: Start import
offers.description: Starts the device reading the pictures `ask` names, stopping an import still under way first.

offers.label: Stop importing
offers.description: Stops the import under way: it ends after the picture it is reading, and what it read so far

offers.label: Try again
offers.description: Tries again the pictures the last import could not read where trying again could help.

offers.label: Refresh folder
offers.description: Reads the photos of a folder again, or of the whole library when no folder is named: their

offers.label: Dismiss the import report
offers.description: Takes the last import's report off the window.

offers.label: Edit album
offers.description: Opens an album draft: the album `id` names as it stands now, or an empty one to start. The

offers.label: Cancel
offers.description: Closes the album draft, saving nothing.

offers.label: Save album
offers.description: Saves the album draft. A photo the draft names that the library no longer holds, or an album

offers.label: Delete album
offers.description: Deletes the album the draft is of. Its photos stay in the library.

offers.label: Dismiss
offers.description: Takes down what the library last had to say.

offers.label: Face scan
offers.description: This person's face scan, started where they have none.

offers.label: On-device recognition
offers.description: Lets this device look for faces in the photos, or stops it: turning it off ends a scan under

offers.label: Scan for faces
offers.description: Starts scanning the photos on this device for faces, or goes on with a paused scan: the model

offers.label: Scan step
offers.description: One batch of a running scan: the next twelve photos it has not read.

offers.label: Pause scanning
offers.description: Pauses the scan under way: scanning again goes on with the next photos.

offers.label: Delete local face data
offers.description: Deletes the face data this person's scans made on this device: the faces nobody named yet and

offers.label: Person named
offers.description: The person the library knows by `name`, started where it knows none.
